entry.title: New: dsh-token-viewer
entry.summary: CC Switch-style token consumption statistics for the dsh web GUI: per-request usage log, real-consumption hero, request-time-bucketed trend chart, per-model peak/off-peak list pricing, per-project and per-model stats, and account balance. Exact install spec: github:qwert702/dsh-token-viewer. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
